conclusion: All ten categories reviewed in stated local/code scope; six open findings; not certification or a fully-secure claim

findings.title: Source intake admits secret-bearing files
findings.confirmation: bounded synthetic intake probe plus inventory/worker/evidence flow review
findings.remediation: Reject secret filenames and private-key material; approve a minimal source/fixture inventory before serialization or execution.

findings.title: Project local-model transport follows cross-origin redirects
findings.confirmation: 302 loopback-to-loopback origin change observed; external SSRF and prompt transmission not exercised
findings.remediation: Reject redirects in LocalModel preflight and generation; retain proxy bypass and bounded responses.

findings.title: Offline export verification has no ZIP expansion limits
findings.confirmation: 131072-byte trust.pub fully decompressed before rejection; no web upload endpoint
findings.remediation: Inspect and bound archive metadata and streaming reads before decompression or signature processing.

findings.title: Container dependency and rebuild provenance gaps
findings.confirmation: 9 unique worker framework advisories; 2 affected setuptools-vendored packaging components across all 3 images; OS candidate scans completed; reachability conditional
findings.remediation: Upgrade compatible frameworks and affected vendored tools; refresh/minimize OS; triage candidate applicability; lock inputs, audit all images, rebuild and requalify.

findings.title: Evidence-integrity denial emits no application security event
findings.confirmation: Controlled tamper returned 409 and no application log events
findings.remediation: Emit sanitized structured integrity events; configure and verify retention, collection and alert delivery.

findings.title: GitHub main lacks enforced branch protection
findings.remediation: Require PR reviews and successful checks; block force push/deletion and constrain bypass permissions.
